card.name: Lead-in to cardiovascular outcome lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a list of cardiovascular events or deaths, such as 'composite of', 'defined as', or 'death,' in trial outcome descriptions.

modes.label: Composite or defined as
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'as' introducing the components of a combined cardiovascular outcome such as MACE.
modes.example: a higher rate of MACE (defined<< as>> cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction

modes.label: Comma inside event list
modes.description: A comma after an event name, with the next event about to be listed.
modes.example: first study occurrence of coronary heart disease death<<,>> nonfatal myocardial infarction,

modes.label: Outcome comparison wording
modes.description: Verbs or quantity words just before an adverse event count or comparison in a trial.
modes.example: There were<< more>> deaths from disease progression in the epo
